metadata.description: Michael Holley's personal marketplace for Claude Code.

plugins.name: dev-workflows
plugins.description: My collection of Claude Code skills, mcps and agents for rapid development workflows.

plugins.name: writing-for-agents
plugins.description: Reference for writing documents an agent consumes - skills, AGENTS.md/CLAUDE.md, and other agent-facing docs - using the same principles that make each one predictable.

plugins.name: to-spec
plugins.description: Turn the current conversation into a spec and publish it to the project issue tracker - synthesis of what you've already discussed, no interview.

plugins.name: to-tickets
plugins.description: Break a plan, spec, or conversation into tracer-bullet tickets, each declaring its blocking edges, published to the configured tracker.

plugins.name: handoff
plugins.description: Compact the current conversation into a handoff document for another agent to pick up.

plugins.name: ponytail
plugins.description: Forces the laziest solution that actually works - YAGNI, stdlib before custom code, native features before dependencies, one line before fifty.

plugins.name: ponytail-review
plugins.description: Code review focused exclusively on over-engineering - finds reinvented stdlib, unneeded deps, speculative abstractions, dead flexibility.

plugins.name: taste-skill
plugins.description: Anti-slop frontend skill for landing pages, portfolios, and redesigns - infers the design direction from the brief and ships interfaces that do not look templated.
